text:
emma.li: Heads up — after we accepted the org transfer for AcmeCorp, a few people in the project report 403 on Project → Settings. They used to be project-maintainers. API calls using their API keys to GET /v1/projects/proj-0a3f2c still work. UI blocks. Anyone seen UI vs API mismatch after transfer?

devon: yep saw this. repro for me: 1) owner accepts transfer 2) members show in org 3) open project settings -> 403. Console shows 'You don't have access to this project'

raj: can you paste a screenshot of the console error and the project id? Also any SSO group changes? sometimes SCIM group mapping drops the 'project-maintainers' claim

emma.li: proj id: proj-0a3f2c; attaching logs (pasted from browser devtools):
```
GET /projects/proj-0a3f2c/settings 403
Authorization: Bearer <session cookie>
X-Org-ID: org-7b9
```

sarah: interesting that API token works. That suggests backend permissions intact but UI gate (authz proxy) denies. I'll check the authz-service logs for role-binding reconcile.

devon: @sarah can you run `authzctl list-bindings --org org-7b9 --subject user:emma.li`?

sarah: ran it, looks like project binding exists but with source=scim and linked_group_id empty. SCIM resync seems to have created a detached binding. filing infra ticket to force rehydrate group membership. temp workaround: re-invite user as project-admin from console (requires org owner).

support-bot: support-ticket#54231 created and linked to infra ticket #INF-871. ETA 4h. Please include affected user list.

raj: workaround that worked for one customer: remove the project binding then readd via `orgctl grant project:maintainer user:emma.li --project proj-0a3f2c`

emma.li: thanks all — reassigning for now. Can infra add a long-term fix? This will catch customers who accept transfers while SCIM group sync is in flight.

sarah: noted. I'll add a reconcile hook on transfer accept to wait for SCIM sync or fallback to group expansion. Adding regression test.

devon: :thumbsup: closing loop once infra confirms.
